purpose: Deferred deep-inspection queue for UK TCC CPOs after exhausting static/browser-fetch discovery. Resume without redoing first/second-pass research when Firecrawl/TinyFish or equivalent network-inspection tooling becomes available.
resumeRule: Start with P1, use dynamic page/app network inspection only, and persist any recovered endpoint immediately in uk-cpo-progress-2026-09.json. Do not repeat generic web searches already completed.

items.name: 3ti Energy Hubs
items.next: after browser automation funding is restored, inspect network requests once and persist Fuuse location/tariff URLs.
items.blocker: Official page demonstrably consumes Fuuse ODA data but the client-specific Fuuse UUID/endpoints are injected dynamically and not exposed in static HTML or WordPress REST content. Live browser/network inspection was attempted but could not start because TinyFish wallet balance is -$1.91.

items.name: Applegreen Electric
items.next: inspect Applegreen Electric app/Driivz tenant network calls.
items.blocker: Applegreen states its charging data is stored in Driivz and updated via API; no public UK PCPR endpoint is indexed.

items.name: Be.EV
items.next: inspect Be.EV/Fuuse network calls or recover client ODA UUID.
items.blocker: Fuuse case study confirms Be.EV migrated to Fuuse and uses its public API capabilities, but the client ODA location/tariff URLs are not publicly indexed.

items.name: E.ON Drive Infrastructure UK
items.next: inspect E.ON Drive/EDRI UK app/map network calls or AMPECO tenant endpoints.
items.blocker: EDRI selected AMPECO for its charging platform; no UK public PCPR endpoint is indexed.

items.name: Zapgo
items.next: inspect Zapgo app/web network calls or AMPECO tenant endpoints.
items.blocker: Zapgo publicly states open-data standards and its charging platform is AMPECO, but no public PCPR endpoint is indexed.

items.name: APCOA Parking UK
items.backend: APCOA Connect integrated with Compleo backend
items.next: inspect APCOA Connect/Compleo network calls and separate Tesla-hosted sites.
items.blocker: APCOA Connect is API-integrated with Compleo and official app provides station/payment data; no indexed public open-data endpoint was found.

items.name: CitiCharge
items.next: inspect CitiCharge app network calls and identify actual backend/party mapping.
items.blocker: CitiCharge app exposes live charger data. Monta Open Data was tested with party_id=CIT and returned an empty dataset; no distinct public CitiCharge endpoint was found.

items.name: Dragon Charging
items.blocker: Official web-app exists and exposes charger use, but no indexed PCPR/open-data endpoint was found after official-domain and API searches.

items.name: EasyGo Charging
items.next: inspect EZO Charging UK app network calls.
items.blocker: EasyGo has rebranded to EZO and the UK app exposes locations/status/tariffs, but no anonymous machine-readable endpoint is indexed.

items.name: Elektra Charge
items.next: inspect Elektra Charge app/site network calls.
items.blocker: Official app/site exposes charger location/status/payment but no indexed PCPR/open-data endpoint.

items.name: Lidl GB / Northern Ireland
items.next: recover Lidl open-data/app backend and reconcile GB*LDL vs GB*LNI and Pod-managed sites.
items.blocker: Current Lidl GB tariffs and EV Roam identities are clear, and Zapmap documents Lidl as sourced from Open Data feeds, but the actual machine-readable feed URL is not publicly indexed. Lidl Plus/app or feed discovery is required to obtain station-level records.

items.name: Qwello UK
items.blocker: Qwello states its own backend is OCPI-compatible and app provides real-time status, but no public UK OCPI/PCPR endpoint is indexed.

items.name: EG On The Move
items.next: inspect EGOTM locator/app backend and separate actual CPO ownership.
items.blocker: Public estate confirmed but includes Tesla-hosted V4 sites; no standalone machine-readable EGOTM PCPR endpoint surfaced.

items.name: Evolo
items.next: inspect app backend and filter own party/operator identifiers.
items.blocker: App exposes charging data but includes roaming partners; no public endpoint found and own-CPO EVSE must be separated from roaming.

items.name: EZ-Charge
items.next: inspect EZ-Charge map/app network calls when browser/app inspection is available.
items.blocker: Official site exposes network/tariff information but no public machine-readable endpoint was discoverable via targeted site/open-data searches. Next route is dynamic map/app network inspection.

items.name: Forward EV
items.blocker: Official driver platform exposes chargers and host-specific tariffs; no indexed public machine-readable endpoint found.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz High-Power Charging UK
items.next: inspect Mercedes-Benz HPC map/app and isolate MBX-owned UK EVSE.
items.blocker: Public CPO identity confirmed but search surfaces MB.CHARGE roaming rather than a dedicated UK PCPR feed; no public endpoint found.

items.name: Voltshare
items.blocker: Voltshare operates its own public/destination network and software platform, but no indexed public PCPR endpoint was found.
